gaps.title: Selected interest response can trap a worker outside work orders
gaps.currentBehavior: Planner selection updates assignment_interest_responses to selected or reserve without creating assignment_personnel. getMyAssignments only returns assignment_personnel rows with status assigned, while selected/reserve/confirmed block reapply.
gaps.risk: Worker sees selected/applied state, cannot reapply, and still has no visible work order.
gaps.recommendedChange: Define selected as non-final or make final confirmation atomically update interest status, upsert assignment_personnel.status assigned, and schedule when slots are filled.

gaps.title: Selected status does not schedule the assignment
gaps.currentBehavior: Assignment status transitions to scheduled only inside assignPersonnel, not when markInterestCandidate sets selected.
gaps.risk: Planning can show selected workers while canonical assignment status remains plannable or otherwise unscheduled.
gaps.recommendedChange: Move scheduling transition into an atomic confirmed-selection/linking path or make UI labels explicit that selected is not scheduled.

gaps.title: Many personnel actions resolve identity by first active user row
gaps.currentBehavior: Several actions select personnel by user_id and is_active only, bypassing the host-bound portal tenant resolver.
gaps.risk: Wrong tenant can be selected for multi-tenant or ambiguous users; module entitlement checks can evaluate the wrong tenant.
gaps.recommendedChange: Centralize a current personnel identity helper that requires current host tenant and tenant-bound personnel row, then use it everywhere.

gaps.title: Legacy RLS/RPC helpers use auth.uid first-row personnel semantics
gaps.currentBehavior: auth_personnel_id and assignment status RPCs select the first personnel row for auth.uid with LIMIT 1.
gaps.risk: Database policies can authorize the wrong personnel row even if app code is later tenant-bound.
gaps.recommendedChange: Replace first-row helpers with tenant/assignment-bound policy predicates or tenant-scoped helper functions.

gaps.title: One worker can change global team assignment status
gaps.currentBehavior: Seen, en route, in progress, completed, not completed, timestamps, notes, and signature are assignment-level state, not per-worker link state.
gaps.risk: Any assigned worker can advance or close the work order for the whole team.
gaps.recommendedChange: Introduce per-worker execution state or execution events, then aggregate assignment status intentionally.

gaps.title: Completion and report submission have race windows
gaps.currentBehavior: Closeout reads status before update and updates by assignment id/tenant. Report submission uses check-then-insert and separately advances assignment status.
gaps.risk: Concurrent workers can produce last-write-wins closeouts or duplicate/partially committed reports.
gaps.recommendedChange: Use transactions, unique constraints where appropriate, and compare-and-set status predicates.

gaps.title: Weekly availability save is destructive and non-atomic
gaps.currentBehavior: Weekly windows are deleted before replacements are inserted.
gaps.risk: Insert failure after delete can erase the weekly schedule.
gaps.recommendedChange: Validate duplicate days before deletion and perform replacement in a transaction.

gaps.title: Leave and organization settings are weakly tenant-bound
gaps.currentBehavior: Leave and settings paths resolve personnel by user only and read organization_settings with limit 1.
gaps.risk: Leave notification routing and availability advance settings can use another tenant's settings.
gaps.recommendedChange: Tenant-filter organization settings and use host-bound personnel identity.

gaps.title: Personnel documents omit explicit tenant/module predicates
gaps.currentBehavior: Document list/download filters by personnel entity only while documents have tenant_id.
gaps.risk: Wrong identity resolution can expose or download documents outside the intended tenant context.
gaps.recommendedChange: Require host-bound tenant identity, include documents.tenant_id predicates, and enforce module access server-side.

gaps.title: Offline queue is not tenant/user scoped
gaps.currentBehavior: All queued work-order actions use one localStorage key and action payloads do not include tenant, personnel, or user binding.
gaps.risk: Queued private data can be replayed or remain visible after logout, login, host switch, or shared-device use.
gaps.recommendedChange: Scope queue keys and records by tenantId, personnelId, and user/session; refuse replay if identity changes.

gaps.title: Duplicate offline replay is not consistently idempotent
gaps.currentBehavior: Replay locking is tab-local. Extra work, report notes, and inventory movements can duplicate, while material usage has stronger clientMutationId handling.
gaps.risk: Two tabs or retry-after-timeout can duplicate extra work, notes, and inventory ledger rows.
gaps.recommendedChange: Add durable mutation IDs, DB unique constraints, and a cross-tab queue lock.

gaps.title: Notification links are sanitized but not recipient-access validated
gaps.currentBehavior: Notification hrefs are constrained to local prefixes, but assignment/ticket access is not validated before display or click.
gaps.risk: Stale or wrongly generated notification links can send users to inaccessible records.
gaps.recommendedChange: Validate target access or fall back to the inbox/messages route for inaccessible targets.

gaps.title: Service-worker notification click allows absolute HTTP(S) hrefs
gaps.currentBehavior: The service worker preserves absolute HTTP(S) targets and opens them on notification click.
gaps.risk: Malformed or compromised push payloads can navigate outside the app.
gaps.recommendedChange: Reject external absolute hrefs in the service worker, matching foreground toast behavior.

gaps.title: Upload-first DB-registration flows can orphan media
gaps.currentBehavior: Client uploads files first and then records DB rows; DB failure can leave unattached storage objects.
gaps.risk: Storage can accumulate inaccessible or unaudited files after partial failures.
gaps.recommendedChange: Add pending-upload registry, server-side cleanup, or compensating cleanup jobs.

gaps.title: Notification queue idempotency support is not used by event enqueue
gaps.currentBehavior: Queue tables have idempotency support, but emitDomainEvent inserts without meaningful idempotency keys.
gaps.risk: Retried domain event emission can duplicate in-app notifications and push/email queue rows.
gaps.recommendedChange: Set deterministic idempotency keys for domain events and notification delivery rows.
